name: Compute headshape.pos file from cHPI recorded during MEG acquisition
summary: Computes time-varying head positions from continuous HPI (cHPI) signals in MEG .fif data with MNE-Python and outputs a headshape.pos file for Maxwell filtering.
description: Uses mne.chpi to compute cHPI amplitudes, coil locations and head positions from the raw .fif and writes them with mne.chpi.write_head_pos. Use it before Maxwell filtering (movement compensation) of MEG recordings made with cHPI. The input must contain cHPI recordings; optional calibration, crosstalk and destination files are passed through.

inputs.description: MEG data in .fif format containing cHPI data.
Optional destination file computed by app-mean-transformation-matrix.

outputs.description: .pos file containing the time-varying head positions. This file will be used during detection of bad channels in MEG data (app-bad-channels) and Maxwell filtering (app-maxwell-filter) steps.

parameters.description: Minimum time step to use to compute cHPI amplitudes. If correlations are sufficiently high, t_step_max. This value can be a float.
Time window to use to estimate the amplitudes. This value can be a float.
The external order for SSS-like interfence suppression to compute cHPI amplitudes. This value must be an integer.
Start time of the raw data to use in seconds to compute cHPI amplitudes. This value can be a float.
End time of the raw data to use in seconds to compute cHPI amplitudes. This value can be a float.
Maximum step to use to compute HPI coils locations. This value can be a float.
How to handle HPI positions too close to sensors when computing HPI coils locations.
If True, adjust the digitization locations used for fitting when computing HPI coils locations.
Minimum distance (m) to accept for coil position fitting when computing head positions. This value can be a float.
Minimum goodness of fit to accept for each coil to compute head positions. This value can be a float.
If True, adjust the digitization locations used for fitting when computing head positions.
